info.name: APFSPN API
info.description:
APFSPN backend API v1. Phase 1: admin and member authentication. Phase 2: member registration, profile and security settings. Phase 3: admin member management and approvals. Phase 4: events, registrations and waitlists. Phase 5: articles, admin users and roles. Phase 6: admin and member dashboards.

Every response uses the envelope {error, message, data}. Machine-readable error codes are in data.code.

Login, Verify, Resend, Forgot Password and Refresh save tokens into the active environment, or into collection variables when no environment is selected. Set otp_code to the code from the email. With MAIL_MAILER=log the email is written to storage/logs/laravel.log; OTP emails are queued, so run `php artisan queue:work` or set QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync locally.

Demo data: run `php artisan db:seed --class=DemoSeeder` (local only). Admin logins use Password123! (superadmin@apfspn.test, manager@, editor@, author@, events@, membership@apfspn.test); member logins use Member123! (adaobi@apfspn.test has 2FA off, chinedu@apfspn.test has 2FA on).

request.description: Returns next_step `authenticated` with tokens and admin, or `verify_otp` with a challenge when APFSPN_ADMIN_TWO_FACTOR is on. Errors: invalid_credentials (401), account_disabled (403), must_reset_password (403).

Use after Login when next_step is verify_otp (APFSPN_ADMIN_TWO_FACTOR on). Sends the login challenge and the emailed code; returns tokens, saved to admin_token and admin_refresh_token. The same URL also verifies reset codes: see "Forgot password: verify OTP". Errors: invalid_otp, otp_expired, stale_challenge_token, otp_blocked, invalid_challenge_token.
mode is send_new (new code and new challenge token), reuse (still in cooldown), or a 429 otp_blocked.
Always returns a challenge, even for unknown emails. The OTP is emailed only for real accounts.

Use after Forgot Password. Sends the reset challenge and the emailed code; returns next_step reset_password and reset_token, saved to admin_reset_token for Reset Password. Errors: invalid_otp, otp_expired, stale_challenge_token, otp_blocked, invalid_challenge_token.
Uses the reset_token from Verify OTP, or the token from an invite link. Clears must_reset_password and revokes all sessions. Error: invalid_reset_token.
Send the refresh token as the bearer. Rotates both tokens. Errors: refresh_token_required, wrong_audience, must_reset_password.
Revokes the current session (access and refresh token) and clears the saved tokens.
Returns the admin with roles and permissions.

item.name: Admin Dashboard
item.description: The admin landing page. Needs an admin access token (admin_token) with dashboard.view. Each section is included only when the admin holds its permission; sections are cached for 60 seconds and cleared when members, events, articles or audit rows change.

request.description: Permission: dashboard.view. Sections: members (members.view): counts_by_status, pending_approvals, new_registrations.this_week/this_month (calendar week from Monday and calendar month in Africa/Lagos). events: upcoming (events.view; next 5 published events with seats_left, null when unlimited) and registrations_this_week (event_registrations.view). articles (articles.view): counts_by_status and awaiting_review {total, items: 5 oldest in review}. recent_activity (audit_logs.view): last 10 audit entries with action, description, admin, subject and created_at. A section the admin cannot view is left out rather than returned as null.

item.name: Admin Members
item.description: Member management for admins. Every request needs an admin access token (admin_token) and the permission named in its description; without it the API returns 403. List and Pending save the first member to member_uuid, and Show saves the member it returns. {{member_uuid}} is the member (user) uuid, not the membership uuid.

request.description: Permission: members.view. Counts: all, pending_approval, active, rejected, suspended, expired.

query.description: Name, email, organisation name or member ID.
pending_approval, active, rejected, suspended or expired.

request.description: Permission: members.view. Newest first. data.items holds MemberResource objects with membership and organisation; data.pagination has current_page, per_page, total, last_page.

exec: const member = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

query.description: Name, email, organisation name or member ID.

request.description: Permission: members.view. Pending applications with a verified email, oldest first. Same filters as List Members except status.

exec: const member = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: members.view. Profile, membership and organisation. organisation.document_url is a signed Cloudinary URL valid for 10 minutes (document_url_expires_at).

exec: const member = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: members.update. Editable: name, phone (unique), bio, directory_visible; individuals also state_code and city; organisations send an organisation object with name, registration_number, address, state_code, city, plus year_established, business_type and website (corporate) or institution_type and department (institutional). Prohibited: email, status, member_id, member_type, approved_at, expires_at, password and document fields. Changes are audited.

Permission: members.approve. Pending members with a verified email only. Issues the member ID (APFSPN + state + sequence), sets status active and expires_at one year out, and emails the member. Approving an active member again returns it unchanged. Errors: invalid_status_transition (with current_status), email_not_verified.
Permission: members.approve. Pending members only; reason is required and is emailed to the applicant. Errors: invalid_status_transition.
Permission: members.suspend. Active members only; reason is required. Errors: invalid_status_transition.
Permission: members.suspend. Suspended members only. Returns to active, or expired if expires_at has passed. Errors: invalid_status_transition.

Permission: members.delete. Only pending or rejected applicants without a member ID. Frees the email and phone, revokes tokens and deletes the private registration document. Approved members return 422 with data.code blocked and data.counts.

query.description: Name, email, organisation name or member ID.
pending_approval, active, rejected, suspended or expired.

request.description: Permission: members.export. Streams text/csv with the same filters as List Members (no pagination). Use Send and Download to save the file.

item.name: Admin Events
item.description: Event management for admins. Every request needs an admin access token (admin_token) and the permission named in its description. List, Create and Show save the event to event_uuid and event_slug. Attendees and Waitlist save the first registration to registration_uuid. Authors can create events and update only their own drafts; publishing needs events.publish and cancelling needs events.cancel.

request.description: Permission: events.view. Newest start first. Each item includes registered_count, waitlisted_count, attended_count and seats_left (null when capacity is unlimited).

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: events.create. Always created as a draft. slug is optional and generated from the title (with -2, -3... when taken). image and speakers[].photo accept a multipart file, a base64 data URI or a URL on our Cloudinary. A venue is required unless is_virtual is true, in which case virtual_link is required. capacity null means unlimited. Prohibited: status, published_at, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason, created_by_admin_uuid, prices.

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: events.view. Includes speakers, virtual_link and the registration counts.

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: events.update, plus the policy: admins without events.publish (authors) can only update their own drafts. Send only the fields to change. speakers, when sent, replaces the whole list: keep a speaker by sending its uuid, omit it to delete it. The slug can change only while the event is a draft. Capacity cannot go below the registered count (capacity_below_registered); raising it promotes waitlisted members in order. Cancelled and completed events cannot be edited (invalid_status_transition).

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: events.publish. Only drafts whose start is still in the future (event_in_past). Publishing a published event returns it unchanged.

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: events.cancel. Only published events. Queues a cancellation email to every registered and waitlisted member. Cancelling again returns the event unchanged and sends nothing.

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: event_registrations.view. Registrations in sign-up order with member contact details.

exec: const registration = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: event_registrations.view. Waitlisted registrations ordered by waitlist_position (1 is next in line).

exec: const registration = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: event_registrations.update. Only registered attendees, once the event has started (event_not_started). Marking again is a no-op.

Permission: event_registrations.export. Streams text/csv: name, email, phone, member_id, member_type, organisation, status, waitlist_position, registered_at, attended_at. Use Send and Download to save the file.
Permission: events.delete. Blocked (422 blocked with counts: registered, waitlisted, attended) while anyone holds a registration; cancel the event instead. Otherwise soft-deletes it.

item.name: Admin Articles
item.description: News and press management. Every request needs an admin access token (admin_token) and the permission named in its description. List, Create and Show save the article to article_uuid and article_slug; Revisions saves the newest revision to revision_uuid. Workflow: draft -> submit -> in_review -> publish / schedule / send back. Authors (articles.submit, no articles.publish) can edit only their own draft or changes_requested articles. Repeating an action whose target state is already reached returns 200 unchanged. Refused transitions return 422 invalid_status_transition with current_status.

query.description: draft, in_review, changes_requested, scheduled, published or archived.

request.description: Permission: articles.view. Newest first. Items omit body and include revision_count.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: articles.create. Always created as a draft authored by the caller. body is sanitised HTML (h2-h4, p, br, ul, ol, li, a, strong, em, blockquote, https img, YouTube iframes). slug is optional and generated from the title. excerpt defaults to the start of the body. cover_image accepts a multipart file, a base64 data URI or a URL on our Cloudinary. Prohibited: status, publish_at, published_at, view_count, author_admin_uuid, reviewer fields. Writes the first revision.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: articles.view. Includes body, review_note, reviewer and revision_count.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: articles.update plus ArticlePolicy: editors (articles.publish) may edit any article except archived ones, including published articles live; authors only their own draft or changes_requested article. Any field from Create; slug is locked once the article has been published. Writes a revision when title, excerpt or body change.
Permission: articles.submit; authors only their own article. draft or changes_requested -> in_review.
Permission: articles.publish. draft, in_review, changes_requested or scheduled -> published. Emails the author unless they published it themselves.
Permission: articles.publish. publish_at must be in the future. articles:publish-scheduled publishes it within a minute of that time. Rescheduling a scheduled article moves the time.
Permission: articles.publish. scheduled -> in_review, publish_at cleared.
Permission: articles.publish. in_review or scheduled -> changes_requested. review_note (3-2000) is required and emailed to the author.
Permission: articles.archive. published -> archived; hidden from the public site.
Permission: articles.archive. archived -> published, keeping the original published_at.
Permission: articles.view. Newest first, with body and edited_by.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: articles.update plus the same policy as Update. Copies the revision title, excerpt and body onto the article and writes a new revision. Restoring identical content changes nothing.
Permission: articles.delete. Soft delete; only draft or archived articles, otherwise 422 invalid_status_transition. The slug stays reserved.

item.name: Admin Users
item.description: Staff accounts. Super admin only by default. Saves admin_uuid from List, Invite and Show. Safety rules: you cannot disable, delete or change the role of yourself (cannot_modify_self); the last active super_admin cannot be disabled, deleted or demoted (last_super_admin); you cannot assign a role or manage an admin with permissions you do not hold (role_exceeds_own_permissions, 403).

request.description: Permission: admins.view. Ordered by name.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: admins.create. Creates the admin with must_reset_password and emails a set-password link (72 hours). Exactly one role. email_taken when the email exists.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: admins.view. Includes roles, permissions and account_state.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: admins.update. name and/or role_uuid. Email cannot change.
Permission: admins.create. Invited admins only (admin_not_invited). Throttled to 3 per minute per admin.
Permission: admins.update. Revokes every token and emails the admin. Disabled admins are refused at login, OTP, refresh and on any token.
Permission: admins.update.
Permission: audit_logs.view. Actions taken by this admin, newest first.
Permission: admins.delete. Blocked (422 blocked with counts.audit_logs, counts.articles, counts.events) once the admin has any activity; disable instead.

item.name: Admin Roles
item.description: Roles and permissions. Super admin only by default. Saves role_uuid from List (first editable role), Create and Show. The super_admin role is locked (role_locked). Built-in roles keep their names (built_in_role_name_locked) but their permissions can be edited, and the seeder never undoes those edits.

request.description: Permission: roles.view. Paginated by name: data.items plus data.pagination. Each role has permissions, admins_count, built_in and locked.

exec: const item = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items.find(r => !r.locked) : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: roles.view. Every permission grouped by module, for the role editor.
Permission: roles.create. name: lowercase snake case, 3-50 chars, unique. You can only grant permissions you hold.

exec: const item = Array.isArray(data) ? data.find(r => !r.locked) : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: roles.view.

exec: const item = Array.isArray(data) ? data.find(r => !r.locked) : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Permission: roles.update. permissions replaces the list. Added permissions must be ones you hold.
Permission: roles.delete. Blocked (counts.admins) while any admin holds it.
Returns next_step `verify_otp` with a challenge when two_factor_enabled (the default), otherwise `authenticated` with tokens and member. Error: invalid_credentials (401).
Completes 2FA login and returns tokens. Errors: invalid_otp, otp_expired, stale_challenge_token, otp_blocked.
mode is send_new (new code and new challenge token), reuse (still in cooldown), or a 429 otp_blocked.
Always returns a challenge, even for unknown emails. The OTP is emailed only for real accounts.
Use after Forgot Password. Verifies the password reset code and returns reset_token, saved to member_reset_token for Reset Password.
Sets a new password and revokes all sessions. The reset token is single-use. Error: invalid_reset_token.
Send the refresh token as the bearer. Rotates both tokens. Errors: refresh_token_required, wrong_audience, account_disabled.
Revokes the current session (access and refresh token) and clears the saved tokens.
Keeps the current session and revokes all others. Error: invalid_current_password.
Returns the member profile.

item.name: Member Dashboard
item.description: The member landing page. Needs a member access token (member_token).

request.description: Member token. welcome_name, organisation_name, membership_card (member_type, member_id, status, approved_at, expires_at, days_until_expiry; negative once expired, null before approval), upcoming_events (next 5 with a registered seat), waitlisted_events (with waitlist_position) and recent_activity (last 10: registrations, approval, profile and security changes; changed_fields lists field names only).

item.name: Member Registration
item.description: Phase 2. Register (pending_approval membership) -> Verify Email -> Create Password, which signs the member in. Registration documents are stored privately on Cloudinary; profile responses carry a short-lived signed `document_url` for the owner and admins only. Locally, `php artisan apfspn:member-verify-code {email}` prints a fresh code and challenge_token without sending email; paste them into otp_code and member_challenge_token.

request.description: Creates the member and a pending_approval membership, then emails a verification code. Returns next_step `verify_email` with a challenge. `photo` is optional: an uploaded file (multipart), a base64 data URI, or an existing URL on our Cloudinary. Prohibited: user_uuid, status, membership_status, member_id, member_type, password. Errors: 422 validation (duplicate email/phone, missing consent).

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Ada Obi",
    "email": "new.member@apfspn.test",
    "phone": "08031234567",
    "bio": "Executive chef with ten years in hotel kitchens.",
    "state_code": "LA",
    "city": "Ikeja",
    "consent": true
}

request.description: Multipart form. `registration_document` (pdf, jpg or png, max 10 MB) is required and stored privately; a base64 data URI also works in a JSON body. URLs are rejected. name, email and phone are the primary contact. Returns next_step `verify_email`.
Multipart form. `letter_of_authorisation` (pdf, jpg or png, max 10 MB) is required and stored privately. Returns next_step `verify_email`.

formdata.description: Official letter of authorisation (pdf, jpg or png)

request.description: Sends a new verification code when the email belongs to an unverified registration. The response is identical for unknown or already verified emails. Modes: send_new, reuse (cooldown), blocked (otp_blocked 429).

Verifies the email, queues the application received email, and returns next_step `create_password` with a password_token. Errors: invalid_otp, otp_expired, stale_challenge_token (409), invalid_challenge_token.

Sets the password and signs the member in: next_step `authenticated` with tokens and the member (membership.status is pending_approval until an admin approves). The password_token is single use. Error: invalid_password_token (422).
Returns the member with membership and organisation. organisation.document_url is a signed URL that expires at document_url_expires_at.

Editable: phone, bio, city, directory_visible, photo. Organisations also: address; corporate: website, business_type; institutional: department. Prohibited: email, name, state_code, organisation name, registration_number, member_type, status, member_id. Omit photo or send null to keep the current one.
PHP does not parse multipart PUT bodies, so send POST with `_method=PUT` to upload a photo file (jpg, png or webp).
Returns two_factor_enabled (on by default).
Turns login email OTP on or off. Turning it off requires current_password. Error: invalid_current_password (422).

item.name: Member Events
item.description: Public event listing (no token) and member registration (member_token). Public List and Show save event_uuid and event_slug. Only members with an active membership can register; pending and expired members get 403 membership_not_active. virtual_link is never public: it is returned on the registration only while the member holds a seat.

query.description: upcoming (not ended, soonest first) or past (ended, latest first).

request.description: No token. Published and completed events. members_only marks events for members; virtual_link is never included.

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: No token. Details, speakers, seats_left and registration_open. Drafts and cancelled events return 404.

exec: const event = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Member token. Registers, or joins the waitlist when the event is full. Registering again returns the existing registration. Errors: membership_not_active (403), event_cancelled, event_completed, registration_closed (422), 404 for drafts.

exec: const registration = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Member token. Frees the seat and promotes the first waitlisted member. Errors: registration_not_found (404), event_started (422).
Member token. The member's registrations with the event nested; cancelled registrations are left out.

exec: const registration = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

item.name: Public Articles
item.description: Public news and press pages. No token. Only published articles are visible; anything else is 404. Showing an article counts a view.

request.description: Published articles, newest first. Items omit body.

exec: const item = data.items ? data.items[0] : (data.uuid ? data : null);

request.description: Published article by slug with the author name. Increments view_count.
